title: Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.22794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model. Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank

translated_title: Ori：面向极低秩大语言模型训练的漂移感知流式k-PCA算法
translated_abstract: 由GaLore开创的一类著名的低秩大语言模型优化器采用梯度子空间投影方法：在每一步中，它们将梯度投影到低维子空间中，并将更新映射回完整模型。现有的大多数工作要么在特定时间间隔重新计算梯度子空间，要么通过事后适配来追赶移动的子空间。在本工作中，我们通过实践明确识别出LLM梯度子空间随时间以缓慢、稳定的方式漂移的特性。为此，我们提出了Ori，一种新颖的低秩LLM训练优化器，它能够捕捉随时间变化的主梯度方向，在严格的低秩约束下实现最先进的准确度。Ori采用了一种受Oja++启发的流式k-PCA算法，其每步计算成本较低，能够实现高频的实时子空间跟踪。在实践中，Ori缩小了最先进的低秩优化器与全秩方法之间的性能差距。
tldr: 提出Ori优化器，利用受Oja++启发的低开销流式k-PCA算法高频跟踪LLM训练中缓慢漂移的梯度子空间，在严格低秩约束下达到最先进的训练精度。
en_tdlr: Ori is a novel low-rank LLM optimizer that employs an Oja++-inspired streaming k-PCA algorithm with low per-step cost to track slowly drifting gradient subspaces at high frequency, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints.
